title: P1D.2 Retrieval Case
description: Schema for every P1D.2 retrieval case across the three evidentiary roles: diagnostic (30, visible), sealed_product_proxy (48, hidden content / manifest-only), real_project_holdout (count TBD, separate). v1.1 adds the reviewer's guards: benchmark_role, richer origin enum, deidentification, leakage control, evidence_lineage_id, source access/license. Draft for user review; NOT frozen.

case_id.description: Globally unique across all three sets. Prefix: diag_/sealed_/holdout_. Family: pd=paper_discovery, er=evidence_retrieval, cr=contradiction_retrieval, mr=method_retrieval, mps=multi_paper_synthesis, rga=research_gap_analysis.

benchmark_role.description: REVIEWER GUARD. Replaces the generic 'sealed' value. Three distinct evidentiary roles: diagnostic (developmental), sealed_product_proxy (independent adversarial validation, may be synthetic), real_project_holdout (derived from actual ERLab projects, required for production activation). A synthetic case may NOT carry real_project_holdout.

query_or_claim.description: The natural-language research question or claim. Verbatim; downstream code must not paraphrase.

retrieved_unit.description: Granularity the product task requires. MUST be 'passage' for evidence_retrieval and contradiction_retrieval (enforced below).

positive_passage_ids.description: Passages that genuinely satisfy the query/claim. Required when retrieved_unit=passage.

hard_topical_negatives.description: At least one hard negative per case (completion gate: cases lacking hard negatives = 0).

false_support_negatives.description: Supportive-seeming language without actual support. Exercises the globally non-compensable risk.

hard_negative_types.description: Concrete risk-shaped negative types. Generic 'wrong topic' alone fails review.

case_origin.description: REVIEWER GUARD (richer enum). synthetic_realistic = invented; synthetic_derived_from_real_structure = abstracted from a real workflow's structure without its content; real_project_deidentified = real content with identifiers removed; real_project_unredacted_controlled = real content, access-controlled. Avoids collapsing invented and real-derived cases into one category.

origin_provenance.description: REVIEWER GUARD. How the case was derived: which project/scenario it models, what was abstracted, who provided it. Required so origin is auditable, not just labeled.

real_project_id.description: REVIEWER GUARD. Present when case_origin is real_project_*. Opaque identifier of the source project. Absent for synthetic origins.

synthetic_scenario_id.description: REVIEWER GUARD. Present when case_origin is synthetic_*. Identifies the scenario template the case was built from. Absent for real_project_* origins.

deidentification_status.description: REVIEWER GUARD. not_applicable_synthetic for invented cases; deidentified/unredacted_controlled for real content; pending_deidentification flags a case not yet cleared for the sealed set.

case_author_id.description: REVIEWER GUARD. Pseudonymous identifier of the case author. Required for independence governance (case author cannot be both reviewers).

review_status.description: provisional = single-pass author only (NOT sealable); dual_reviewed = two independent reviewers agreed; adjudicated = disagreements resolved.

reviewer_a_id.description: REVIEWER GUARD. Pseudonymous. Must differ from case_author_id and reviewer_b_id.

reviewer_b_id.description: REVIEWER GUARD. Pseudonymous. Must differ from case_author_id and reviewer_a_id.

adjudicator_id.description: REVIEWER GUARD. Pseudonymous. Required when any judgment is adjudicated. Must not be a policy developer.

policy_outputs_visible_to_reviewers.description: REVIEWER GUARD. MUST be false for sealed cases. Reviewers cannot inspect retrieval-policy outputs.

reviewers_blinded_to_each_other.description: REVIEWER GUARD. MUST be true for dual_reviewed/adjudicated cases.

independence_exception.description: REVIEWER GUARD. If any independence rule is relaxed, document why. Absent means no exception.

leakage_group_id.description: REVIEWER GUARD (leakage control). Cases sharing a topic/source are grouped; the leakage audit uses this to flag diagnostic-vs-sealed topical overlap beyond exact string equality.

document_family_id.description: REVIEWER GUARD (leakage control). Groups source documents that are versions/derivatives of one another.

query_semantic_fingerprint.description: REVIEWER GUARD (leakage control). SHA-256 of a canonical semantic form of the query. Lets the leakage audit catch near-duplicate queries across sets without exact string equality.

positive_unit_fingerprint.description: REVIEWER GUARD (leakage control). SHA-256 of the canonical positive unit. Catches the same passage reused across sets.

passages.description: Passage-level evidence keyed by passage_id. Required when retrieved_unit=passage.

passage_locator.description: REVIEWER GUARD. start/end offsets or stable locator. Exact, not approximate.

passage_text_hash.description: SHA-256 of the exact passage text. Drift detection.

document_content_hash.description: REVIEWER GUARD. SHA-256 of the whole source document. Drift detection at document level.

source_access_or_license_basis.description: REVIEWER GUARD. How ERLab is permitted to use this source (license, subscription, public domain, etc.).

evidence_lineage_id.description: REVIEWER GUARD. REQUIRED for multi-paper-synthesis diversity measurement. Distinct papers are NOT necessarily distinct lineages; this ID groups papers sharing an evidence lineage (same lab, same dataset, same trial family).

allOf.description: evidence_retrieval requires retrieved_unit=passage (P1D.1 coverage gap fix).
passage_requirement: if retrieved_unit=passage, positive_passage_ids and passages must be present.
contradiction_requirement: contradiction_retrieval cases must have contradicting_or_qualifying_passages.
multi_paper_synthesis must exercise redundancy AND have evidence_lineage_id in its passages (diversity measurement requires lineage).
REVIEWER GUARD: real_project_holdout role requires real_project_* origin. A synthetic case cannot carry the real-project-holdout role.
REVIEWER GUARD: synthetic origin requires synthetic_scenario_id.
REVIEWER GUARD: real_project origin requires real_project_id.
REVIEWER GUARD: provisional cases cannot be dual_reviewed. (review_status=provisional means single-pass; review_status=dual_reviewed means two reviewers agreed — these are mutually exclusive.)
REVIEWER GUARD: dual_reviewed/adjudicated cases must name both reviewers (independent) and be blinded.
REVIEWER GUARD: sealed_product_proxy and real_project_holdout roles must NOT have policy outputs visible to reviewers.
